strategy.overview: Before the first plunge, use the right flipper to choose level I, II, or III; the choice lasts all game. On each plunge, time the shooter-lane switch for the blue Rider light and 50,000 points. Build **MILLION with the flashing center standup or a lit-SPOT ramp shot, then shoot the Turbo Saucer after the full phrase is lit for 1,000,000.
strategy.simpleOverview: Before the first plunge, choose level I, II, or III with the right flipper. Time each plunge for the blue Rider light. Shoot the flashing center standup or a lit-SPOT ramp to build **MILLION, then shoot the Turbo Saucer for 1,000,000.
strategy.summary: Choose a skill level before the first plunge, time the blue Rider skill shot, build **MILLION at the flashing center standup or lit-SPOT ramp, then shoot the Turbo Saucer for 1,000,000.

quickInfo.name: Choose a Level
quickInfo.summary: Use the right flipper before the first shooter-lane switch.

quickInfo.name: Make the Skill Shot
quickInfo.summary: Stop the moving Rider light on blue for 50,000.

quickInfo.name: Build **MILLION
quickInfo.summary: Use the flashing center standup or the ramp after SPOT is lit.

quickInfo.name: Collect a Million
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the Turbo Saucer after the full phrase is lit.

steps.text: Before the first plunge reaches the shooter-lane switch, press the right flipper to select level I, II, or III.
Time the plunge so the moving Rider lights stop on blue for the 50,000-point skill shot.
Shoot the ramp repeatedly until SPOT lights, then use the ramp or the flashing center standup to add **MILLION letters.
After **MILLION is complete, shoot the Turbo Saucer for 1,000,000 points.

alternatives.title: Complete the Lightning Bolts
alternatives.when: Use this when the outside targets are safer than the center standup and ramp.

steps.text: Complete the Lightning Bolt targets; level I allows any order, while levels II and III require the sequence.
The completion awards 25,000 on level I, Extra Ball on level II, or Special on level III before operator conversions.
Level I scores 1x with easier target rules and requires both stars before **MILLION.
Level II scores 2x and starts with one star; level III scores 3x, starts with both stars, and uses the hardest timed target rules.

machineSetup: Confirm Extra Ball and Special conversions, ball count, and whether the level-selection display and right-flipper input respond before the first plunge.
Test the Rider shooter-lane lights, ramp and SPOT threshold, center standup, Turbo Saucer, Lightning Bolt targets, star lamps, and target-bank reset timing.

cautions.issue: The skill level locks for the rest of the game when the first shooter-lane switch closes.
cautions.response: Make the level choice before plunging; do not expect the flipper buttons to change it afterward.
